start.content: I was there that morning, having come from Cana. The women told us about the empty tomb, and we hurried back to the shore.

observation.content: I helped haul the net. 153 fish—large ones. The miracle wasn't just in catching them, but that the net held at all.

response.content: Peter was pale when Jesus asked about love. Three times. The threefold question for his threefold denial. But there was no reproach—only grace.
